_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written from scratch for Raptor.
name: Minecraft: PocketMine-MP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: PocketMine-MP, a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server written in PHP that runs its own plugins. Installs any release with the PHP build made for it, both checked against GitHub's checksums.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: PocketMine-MP. Downloads a PocketMine-MP release and the PHP
# build made for it from GitHub, both checked against GitHub's checksums.
# Worlds, plugins, players and settings are never touched; the server and
# PHP are only replaced once the new ones have arrived whole.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# PocketMine-MP's PHP is built for x86-64 Linux only.
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "PocketMine-MP's PHP is only built for x86-64 servers, and this one is $(uname -m)."

want="${PMMP_VERSION:-latest}"
if ! tag=$(gh-release tag pmmp/PocketMine-MP "$want" 2>&1); then
    case "$tag" in
    *"has no release"*) fail "PocketMine-MP has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 5.44.3." ;;
    *) fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again." ;;
    esac
fi
assets=$(gh-release assets pmmp/PocketMine-MP "$tag") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
grep -q '^PocketMine-MP.phar ' <<<"$assets" || fail "PocketMine-MP $tag has no server download. Choose another version."
grep -q '^build_info.json ' <<<"$assets" || fail "PocketMine-MP $tag doesn't say which PHP it needs. Choose a newer version."
gh-release download pmmp/PocketMine-MP "$tag" build_info.json "$work/build_info.json" || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
php_tag=$(jq -r '.php_download_url // empty' "$work/build_info.json" | sed 's#.*/releases/tag/##')
php_version=$(jq -r '.php_version // empty' "$work/build_info.json")
mcpe=$(jq -r '.mcpe_version // "?"' "$work/build_info.json")
[ -n "$php_version" ] || fail "PocketMine-MP $tag doesn't say which PHP it needs. Choose a newer version."
major=${tag%%.*}

sum=$(awk '$1 == "PocketMine-MP.phar" { print $2 }' <<<"$assets")
if [ -f PocketMine-MP.phar ] && [ "$sum" != - ] && [ "$(sha256sum PocketMine-MP.phar | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "PocketMine-MP $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading PocketMine-MP $tag"
    gh-release download pmmp/PocketMine-MP "$tag" PocketMine-MP.phar PocketMine-MP.phar || fail "The download from GitHub failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi

# The PHP build the release names, or (older releases name none) PMMP's
# newest build of that PHP for this PocketMine-MP generation.
php_file=""
for t in $php_tag "pm$major-php-$php_version-latest"; do
    php_assets=$(gh-release assets pmmp/PHP-Binaries "$t" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    linux=$(grep -E '^PHP-[^ ]*Linux-x86_64[^ ]*\.tar\.gz ' <<<"$php_assets" | grep -v debugging) || continue
    read -r php_file php_sum < <(grep -E "PM$major\.tar" <<<"$linux" || head -n 1 <<<"$linux")
    php_tag=$t
    break
done
[ -n "$php_file" ] || fail "PMMP has no Linux build of PHP $php_version for PocketMine-MP $tag, or GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
php_id="$php_tag $php_file $php_sum"
if [ -x bin/php7/bin/php ] && [ "$(cat bin/.raptor-php 2>/dev/null)" = "$php_id" ]; then
    echo "PHP $php_version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading PHP $php_version for PocketMine-MP"
    gh-release download pmmp/PHP-Binaries "$php_tag" "$php_file" "$work/php.tar.gz" || fail "The PHP download from GitHub failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p "$work/php"
    tar -xzf "$work/php.tar.gz" -C "$work/php"
    [ -x "$work/php/bin/php7/bin/php" ] || fail "The PHP download didn't have PHP in it. Reinstall to try again."
    # PHP finds its extensions (opcache) where the server runs.
    ext=$(cd "$work/php/bin/php7/lib/php/extensions" && ls -d no-debug-zts-* | head -n 1)
    echo "extension_dir=\"/home/container/bin/php7/lib/php/extensions/$ext\"" >> "$work/php/bin/php7/bin/php.ini"
    echo "$php_id" > "$work/php/bin/.raptor-php"
    rm -rf bin.old
    if [ -e bin ]; then mv bin bin.old; fi
    mv "$work/php/bin" bin
    rm -rf bin.old
fi
echo "Installed PocketMine-MP $tag (Minecraft: Bedrock Edition $mcpe) with PHP $php_version."
